output.summary: The cadence slip is explained by the single-reviewer security gate. Pipeline time added is entirely between QA pass and AppSec sign-off (E5). Review throughput is flat at about 4.5 per week while submissions exceed it, so the queue grows (E4). Per-review time is stable (E4). The August full-time delegate cleared the queue and six releases shipped, with no other process changes (E6). Non-gated Reporting patches kept a 14-day cadence (E12). Engineer output (E7), technical debt (E11) and the idle-ticket mix (E9) argue against discipline and debt as causes. Morale is a likely downstream effect, but its causal role is unestablished. Add review capacity now. Do not suspend the gate or run the accountability program. Risk-tiered scope changes need review-outcome data (Q1) first.
